lines.speaker: Bu Laras
lines.text: Ah, another traveler. The road to this settlement is long, isn't it?

lines.speaker: Bu Laras
lines.text: Adventurers from every corner of the archipelago gather here to rest before heading out.

lines.speaker: Bu Laras
lines.text: Be careful out there. The old seals are weakening, and things are stirring in the forgotten places.

lines.speaker: Bu Laras
lines.text: Come back and tell me what you find.
For generations, the human world and the supernatural world kept their distance.
Ancient civilizations raised temples and fortresses across the archipelago, sealing powerful relics and forces within them.
Now the old stories are forgotten, and the seals are beginning to weaken.
A cloaked traveler leans against the old shrine gate, watching you approach.

lines.speaker: Rangga
lines.text: You're not from around here either, are you?
He tilts his head toward the path leading into the forest.

lines.speaker: Rangga
lines.text: Take my advice: don't go in without a good blade.
